usage: 紅色 refers to the color red and can be used both as a noun and an adjective to describe something that is red in color.
When describing clothes or objects, 紅色 usually comes before the noun, e.g., 紅色衫 (red shirt).
It can also stand alone as a noun when talking about colors in general, e.g., 我鍾意紅色 (I like red).
紅色 is a basic color word, so it is often used in daily conversation about style, shopping, or describing things.
You can pair 紅色 with other descriptive words to form casual expressions, such as 深紅色 (dark red) or 淺紅色 (light red).
